summary: Phase 2b.1: LAN companion + WebRTC DataChannel transport with manual SDP paste. Shipped a typed wire contract (`app/src/phone/wire.ts`, PhoneMessage = `commit | ping`, encode/decode/isPhoneMessage with strict type-tag validation) and an RTCPeerConnection wrapper (`app/src/phone/peer.ts`, role-aware createOffer/acceptOffer/acceptAnswer/send/onMessage/onStateChange/close, default STUN stun.l.google.com:19302, peerConnectionFactory injection for tests). New `/phone` route on the same Vite SPA via a `/^\/phone(\/|$)/` test in `main.tsx`. PhoneApp (phone-side) ships paste-offer / generate-answer / Send-commit; PairScreen (laptop-side) ships generate-offer / paste-answer / Connect with a 'Last commit received at +Xms' debug surface that satisfies the §B2 testing-gate concession by giving manual QA a laptop-observable signal. Settings gained an optional `laptopLanIp` field that round-trips through Dexie and feeds the displayed phone URL; the 'Pair phone' button auto-saves before navigating so the PairScreen's `loadSettings()` read sees fresh state. vite.config.ts gained `server.host: true` and `preview.host: true` so the phone can reach the laptop on LAN. docs/QUALITY_GATES.md grew a 'Browser-API limitations (Phase 2b)' footnote codifying the scoped testing-gate concession recorded in artifacts/decision-memo.md §B2. 25 new vitest tests (130 total, all green): 9 wire round-trip/rejection tests, 15 peer state-machine tests including a regression for the ondatachannel+onopen race during answerer ICE gathering, 1 settings round-trip test for `laptopLanIp`. Lint + tsc + vite build all clean. Bundle 349.80 KB JS / 107.55 KB gzip (+2.26 KB gzip vs the Phase 5 baseline of 105.29; well under the +20 KB gzip budget). Reviewer (`code-reviewer`) returned APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES with one explicit conditional (manual_qa field populated; see review notes) plus seven non-blocking observations. The cheap correctness fixes were applied before approval: answerer race guard with regression test, exact-match /phone route, dropped unreachable port fallback, removed misleading removeEventListener cleanup that was a no-op for property-assigned handlers. Phase 2b.1's WebRTC transport handshake itself is gated by the manual_qa checklist (M1–M5 in `artifacts/phase-2b1-verify/results.json`) per the §B2 concession; the autonomous loop cannot perform real-device QA, so M1–M5 are recorded as `pending operator sign-off` in the approval artifact's `manual_qa` block — the operator (athlete on a real LAN with a phone) signs them off after this commit lands.

gates.testing: 130/130 vitest tests pass (Phase 5 baseline was 105; +25 new). Every new public behavior in wire.ts and peer.ts has at least one would-fail-if-reverted test; the race-fix regression test (peer.test.ts 'does not regress state to connecting if the channel opens during ICE gathering') gates the answerer state machine. Code-reviewer observation #5 (settings load/save field-list duplication) is pre-existing from Phase 4 and unchanged in shape by this phase — flagged for follow-up, not introduced here. PhoneApp/PairScreen duplication is intentional throwaway scaffolding per memo §'Throwaway scaffolding'.
gates.drift: No prior-phase invariants touched. RepRecord / SessionRecord / Dexie schema version unchanged. SettingsRecord widened by one optional field (`laptopLanIp?: string`) — additive, backward-compatible. ProfileRecord untouched. Phase 4 + Phase 5 functionality preserved (verified by 105 baseline tests passing alongside the 25 new ones).
gates.planning: decision-memo.md (Phase 2b decomposition) is the planning artifact. Phase 2b.1 acceptance criteria match docs/PHASES.md § Phase 2b.1 and the memo's §'Sub-phase 2b.1 — LAN companion-page + WebRTC DataChannel with manual SDP'.

review.architecture_red_team: Reviewed the Phase 2b decomposition in the prior iteration. Four blocking concerns (B1 LAN-trust model, B2 testing-gate concession, B3 falsifiable 2b.3 criteria, B4 Android-gated acceptance) resolved in artifacts/decision-memo.md before any 2b.1 code was written.
review.code_reviewer: APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES on the implementation. Single conditional was manual_qa field population — addressed in the `manual_qa` block above with explicit operator-sign-off instructions. Seven non-blocking observations: (1) answerer race fix APPLIED with regression test, (2) waitForIceComplete listener-cleanup mismatch APPLIED (dropped no-op removeEventListener), (3) wire.ts validator shape DEFERRED to 2b.3 when new payload variants land, (4) exact-match /phone route APPLIED, (5) settings field-list duplication DEFERRED — pre-existing and unchanged in shape, (6) PhoneApp/PairScreen duplication ACCEPTED (intentional throwaway), (7) unreachable port fallback APPLIED (window.location.port is always present when the SPA is loaded).
review.qa_playwright: Phase 2b.1 transport is gated by manual real-device QA per QUALITY_GATES.md §'Browser-API limitations (Phase 2b)' — see manual_qa block. Automated UI gate checks C1–C4 in verify-phase-2b1.mjs all PASS with zero console errors; C5 best-effort WebRTC handshake fails under headless chromium without UDP, as documented and expected. Phase 4 + Phase 5 regression: not separately re-run this iteration; covered by the full vitest suite (130/130) which gates the analytics + drill + profiles modules unchanged in this phase.
